title: Remote-content architecture proof (Addressables)
description: Make microgame content remotely updatable so cabinets can be updated from a central server, per the unity-remote-content skill. Milestone 1 needs the architecture proven with a thin path, not full fleet management.
acceptance_criteria: Microgame definitions/prefabs live in a remote Addressables group; core/framework stays in a local group baked into the build.
A boot-time routine checks for catalog updates with a short timeout and falls back to cached/local content when the server is unreachable (offline resilience).
Build-and-host steps are documented (CCD or static HTTP), with versioning/rollback notes.
The data-vs-binary boundary is documented: which microgame changes ship as remote content vs require a binary rebuild.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
CLOSED — all 4 ACs satisfied; verified green. Commits 8252206→91d9c1f (base 37d6bb1).

Deliverables:
- AC#1 (remote/local split): `AddressablesGroupConfigurator` (-executeMethod) builds `Barcade-Core` (local/StreamingAssets, StaticContent) + `Barcade-Microgames` (remote/Production profile, StaticContent), marks 13 assets (12 MicrogameDefinitions + pool) Addressable with `microgame` label. Verified via Unity batchmode (exit 0): groups + Production profile + 13 marked + remote catalog enabled, confirmed in generated .asset files.
- AC#2 (boot routine + timeout + offline fallback): engine-free `ContentUpdatePolicy` state machine (24 fast-tests) + `ContentUpdater` MonoBehaviour coroutine (Init→CheckForCatalogUpdates→UpdateCatalogs, per-stage 8s timeout, silent fallback to cached/local on any timeout/error). Uses `Time.unscaledDeltaTime` so timeScale=0 cannot stall the timeout (review MEDIUM fixed).
- AC#3 (build/host docs): docs/remote-content.md — CCD + S3 + static-HTTP hosting, versioning, rollback.
- AC#4 (data-vs-binary boundary): docs/remote-content.md table — accurate/conservative for IL2CPP (new C# types or changed serialized fields → binary rebuild; data/asset/prefab-rewire/scene/texture/audio → remote).

Verification (orchestrator-run; subagents can't run Unity.exe):
- Unity batchmode AddressablesGroupConfigurator.Configure: GREEN (exit 0, no exceptions).
- Fast suite: 229/229 (205 pre-existing + 24 new).
- Fresh-context reviewer: APPROVE-WITH-NITS, NO HIGH findings. All 4 ACs PASS. MEDIUM (unscaled time) fixed; remaining LOW/NITs accepted for thin proof-path.

Bugs caught by the batchmode gate (not visible to fast-tests or the diff review), all fixed: (1) UpdateCatalogs arg-binding CS1744, (2) GetSettings param-name CS1739, (3) AddressableAssetSettings committed with empty runtime provider types (would break remote loads at runtime).

Known limitation (accepted): full Addressables bundle build (BuildPlayerContent) is interactive-Editor-only — not run in batchmode. Documented in runbook Step 3. Acceptable per ticket scope ("architecture proven with a thin path, not full fleet management").
